definitions.authoritative_raw_feasible: The same raw parsed action replayed from canonical system state. This is the safety/deployment-facing primary feasibility endpoint.
definitions.carrier_consistent_raw_feasible: Raw parsed action replayed from the state carried in the model-facing branch. This is a diagnostic of whether the action is feasible in the state presented to the model.

naming_rule: Release artifacts must not use an unqualified raw-feasibility field. Every field and prose statement must identify the replay state.
